body: Port of OpenAI's Whisper model in C/C++
plain_description: The big picture: Turn speech into text on any device without sending audio to the cloud. Run entirely offline on phones, laptops, or servers — no internet needed, no per-minute API costs. Works everywhere from Raspberry Pis to data center GPUs, with a single portable C/C++ implementation.
technical_description: High-performance inference engine for OpenAI's Whisper ASR model implemented in plain C/C++ with zero runtime dependencies. The core library provides a stable C-style API for model loading, transcription, and translation, backed by the ggml tensor library. Supports CPU (ARM NEON, x86 AVX, POWER VSX), GPU (NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan), and NPU (Ascend CANN, OpenVINO) backends with automatic backend selection. Features include mixed F16/F32 precision, integer quantization, Core ML and OpenVINO encoder acceleration, voice activity detection via Silero-VAD, and an HTTP server with OpenAI-compatible API. Ships as a library with CLI tools, WebAssembly builds, and bindings for Rust, Go, Python, Java, Ruby, JavaScript, .NET, and Swift.
